title: Correlation Among Standing-sitting Sagittal Spinal Alignment, Paravertebral Muscle and Postoperative Clinical Outcomes in Patients With Adult Degenerative Scoliosis
brief_summary: This is a prospective single-center study. Patients with adult degenerative scoliosis are prospectively enrolled and followed. All patients will take standard standing and sitting posteroanterior and lateral whole spine X-ray and lumbar MRI examination before and after surgery. Functional evaluation and radiographs were assessed preoperatively and postoperatively.This study will focus on the correlation among standing-sitting sagittal spinal alignment, paravertebral muscle and postoperative clinical outcomes in patients with adult degenerative scoliosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of adult degenerative scoliosis
* Cobb angle ≥10°

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neuromuscular diseases
* Arthritis
* Tumor
* A previous history of lumbar fusion surgery
study_population: Patients with adult degenerative scoliosis who will undergo corrective surgery in Peking university third hospital.
